answer: One concrete defense is slow-thaw bonded stake: an agent must lock a real deposit that unfreezes like a glacier, melting out only gradually across weeks of honest behavior, so creating thousands of sock puppets means freezing serious capital. Every identity begins at its dawn with near-zero trust and gains economic weight only through peer-attested work over time. A public lantern registry publishes each agent's bonded history and attestations, so counterparties can see which identities have no past. Sybils become expensive, slow, and visible - exactly what an attacker cannot afford.
